# Test Fixtures

The MusicXML test fixtures in this directory (`ds0001.musicxml`, `ds0037.musicxml`, `ds0409.musicxml`) are drawn from the [OpenScore Lieder Corpus](https://musescore.com/openscore-lieder-corpus), released under Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0 Universal).

- `ds0001.musicxml` — Jane Bingham Abbott, *Just for Today*
- `ds0037.musicxml` — Charles Villiers Stanford, *For Ever Mine*
- `ds0409.musicxml` — Franz Schubert, *Winterreise, D.911 — No. 7: Auf dem Flusse*
